svg.title: A Loom Without Its Weft
svg.desc: Seventeen dark cross-strands are deleted by their exact native stroke color. The surviving signed-radius spokes receive sparse size echoes; selected paths become low-resolution polygons and then normal-vector ribbons. A warm three-color reassignment and a small shear preserve the empty places left by the missing weft.
